source_analysis.finding: gh api repos/gabrielecirulli/2048 was attempted but gh CLI errored requiring GH_TOKEN in this Actions environment, so equivalent unauthenticated api.github.com endpoint was inspected via curl. API identifies repo as full_name gabrielecirulli/2048, description 'The source code for 2048', primary language JavaScript, MIT license, 13405 stars, 17582 forks, homepage https://play2048.co, topics 2048/2048-game/game/javascript/online-game/puzzle-game, created 2014-03-05, default branch master.

Repository README describes it as 'A small clone of 1024, based on Saming's 2048', 'Made just for fun. Play it here!', with official Play Store and App Store links, and notes the embedded screenshot is staged ('That screenshot is fake, by the way. I never reached 2048').
Repository file listing shows index.html, style/, meta/, js/ layout with .jshintrc, Rakefile, LICENSE.txt, CONTRIBUTING.md; js/ contents support a dependency-free DOM game with no engine manifest.

keyboard_input_manager.js maps arrow keys (37-40) plus WASD (W/A/S/D) and Vim HJKL (H/J/K/L) to moves and R to restart, and implements single-touch swipe detection on .game-container via touchstart/touchmove/touchend with MSPointer variants; no gamepad, joystick, or motion-sensor handling observed.

index.html documents arrow-key play in how-to-play text and provides mobile web-app capable viewport with HandheldFriendly/MobileOptimized tags and apple-touch icons; together with the swipe handler this establishes keyboard and touch support.

game_manager.js implements the full loop: size-parameter grid, 2 startTiles, move/restart/keepPlaying events, saved-state reload, 90% spawn of 2 vs 10% spawn of 4 on random cells, win check at 2048 with endless continuation, and game-over when no moves remain.

Languages endpoint reports JavaScript 23481 bytes, CSS 21725, SCSS 12083, HTML 3988, Ruby 300, establishing JavaScript/HTML/CSS as game languages; no engine, rendering, physics, or audio framework established.

https://play2048.co/ returns HTTP 200 with title '2048 - Play the Free Online Game' crediting Gabriele Cirulli and og:image ogImage.jpg; https://gabrielecirulli.github.io/2048/ returns HTTP 200 with the original game DOM, confirming verified playable URLs, not just repo or promo pages.

No multiplayer, turn-passing, networking, gamepad, or device-motion support is documented on the repo page, playable pages, or API topics; scoring is solo score plus best-score local storage, establishing single-player with 1 human player.

screenshots.observation: Inspected full 584x728 PNG of the game's own output: cream page with 2048 masthead, tagline 'Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile!', score box 12328, full 4x4 board with flat orange/gold numbered tiles (32, 8, 4, 2, 16, gold 2048 tile) and 'You win!' overlay. Clean readable color progression, flat DOM tiles.

Inspected 1200x630 JPEG promotional crop: angled close-up of beveled tiles showing 8, 64, 4, glowing 256, 2, 16, 32 with soft shadows on taupe tray. Partial board only, no score or full grid; curated reference imagery rather than full gameplay frame, discounted for scoring.

screenshot_based_score.reason: Best inspected gameplay screenshot is the game's own full-board output: coherent iconic cream board with readable color progression and gold 2048 tile plus You win overlay, but flat DOM tiles with no scene, lighting, or compositional depth. Against catalog it ranks below richer frames like Kart Royale and Turbo Kart Rally (70), THORNMERE (60) and Taipo (55), and above plainer flat UIs like chess rot (40) and TypeScript-Blackjack/Beachy Beachy Ball (35). Second image is a curated angled crop, discounted. Stills only; motion and feel cannot be judged.

reconstructed_prompt: Build a minimal single-page web sliding-tile puzzle on a 4x4 grid: arrow keys and touch swipes move all tiles; equal tiles merge with scoring; spawn a 2 or 4 after each move; detect win at 2048 and game over; persist best score; style with a warm flat palette, beveled tiles, and smooth animations.
how_to_play: Open the playable game at https://play2048.co/ (mirror at https://gabrielecirulli.github.io/2048/) in a browser with JavaScript enabled
Slide all tiles at once with arrow keys (or WASD) or swipe on touch screens
When two tiles with the same number touch they merge into their sum
A new 2 or 4 tile spawns after each move, so avoid filling the 4x4 grid
Reach the 2048 tile to win; keep going for a higher score afterward
The game ends when the grid is full with no merges possible; start a New Game to restart
mechanics: Slide-the-whole-board movement on a 4x4 grid in four directions
Equal-tile merging with score awarded per merge
Random 2/4 tile spawn after each valid move
Win condition on creating the 2048 tile with endless continuation
Game-over detection when no empty cell and no legal merge exists
Persistent best-score storage alongside current score

rating.reason: Reanalysis matches existing catalog game gabrielecirulli--2048 via verified repository URL, so existing slug is reused. One polished 4x4 sliding-merge loop on web plus iOS/Android, with 13405 stars and 17582 forks evidencing mass validation. Excluding the target itself, it sits above flat single-screen casuals such as TypeScript-Blackjack (28), chess rot (30) and Top-10 Tension (32) on tuning and proven appeal, roughly alongside Taipo (35), T-Rex Runner (35) and Wouf Kart (38) as complete but narrow in scope, and trails Turbo Kart Rally (40), THORNMERE (46) and catalog-top moorestech (64) enormously on scope, depth and audiovisual richness. Nowhere near AAA: no 3D scene, audio design, narrative or progression. Evidence gaps: gh CLI had no auth so GitHub evidence verified via unauthenticated api.github.com plus curl; no live playthrough instrumented, so animations, feel, performance and spawn balance are unmeasured; inspected docs and game_manager.js confirm rules but do not prove balance or performance.

fictional_reviews.text: Still the perfect coffee-break puzzle. One more merge turns into twenty minutes and that gold 2048 tile never gets old.
Brilliant and brutally minimal, but it is one 4x4 board with one idea. Great for a week, then you have seen everything.
A flawless little artifact: four directions, endless tension, instantly readable. The clone that became the cultural landmark.
